Pete: I've got room for two more plates and your dessert.

Carl: Hey! Who touched my towel?

defeat: Carl: I'm playing dead. For real this time.

Carl: Ten frames of shame. The Bandits will never let me forget.

taunt: Rodney: That's a cane, not a stick. Wrong sport, grandpa.
Rodney: Purse checks? Lady, I've been hit harder by waves.
Rodney: Otters were born for this. You were born in 1940.
Rodney: Another one in the net? Ha! Wrong net.
Rodney: Hope you two can swim. Harbor's right there.
hurt: Rodney: Hey! That check was legal? Fine.
Rodney: Splash! Ugh, my fur. My beautiful fur.
Rodney: Okay, the old folks can move.
defeat: Rodney: Five goals? From a cane? I need a nap.
Rodney: Otters, back to the water. We'll train harder.
Rodney: Good game, grandpa. You and Mavis are legit.

loading_tips: Pit Beef Pete slides food onto your plate. Swat it back fast.
Hiccups during the eating contest? Tap the prompt, then sip lemonade.
Duckpin balls are small. Aim for the pocket, not the moon.
Kingpin Carl's towel isn't really lucky. Probably.
Check an Otter into the harbor and he sits out for 30 seconds.
Mavis's purse makes a great lacrosse stick. Don't ask how.
Phantoms hate lantern light. Flash them and watch them scatter.
The Fells Point Phantoms only come out at night. Plan accordingly.
Chompy eats junk, not fish. Reel in the boots and feed the wheel.
Rare catches show up more at dawn. Harold is up early anyway.
In the Grand Prix, brake BEFORE the hairpin. Not during. Not after.
Crow sentries can't see you in deep shadow. Stay dark.
Lost in the market? Follow the smell of pit beef.
Bike Life tip: lean back to keep the front wheel up.
The Penthouse Pigeon drops flowerpots. Look up, then climb.
Neighbors in windows sometimes help. Sometimes they just yell.
Every cleared district throws a party. You're invited.
Drone goggles show the whole city. Try them after the finale.
Wheelie Kings respect speed. Bertie respects winning.
A good grandpa naps between boss fights. Harold disagrees.
tutorial_tips: Eating contest: tap EAT in rhythm, and watch the fullness meter.
When Pete pushes food your way, tap SWAT before it lands on your plate.
Duckpin: drag to aim, release to roll. You get three balls per frame.
Lacrosse: SWING to pass or shoot, ACT to check a defender.
Stealth: move slowly in shadows. Running makes noise.
Fishing: tap CAST, wait for the bite, then hold REEL and ease off when the line glows red.
Feed junk catches to Chompy by tapping FEED on the pier.
Racing: hold GAS, tap BRAKE before corners, steer with the stick.
Bike Life: hold JUMP to lift the front wheel, tilt to balance.
Climbing: tap left and right to grab ledges. Dodge falling pots.
Night only: raise your lantern with ACT to scare phantoms away.
Open the drone view after the finale to fly over the cleared city.
